blockingLoop.evidence: 'Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it, what is it doing, and is anything showing on the display or control panel?' asked three times after the customer had already answered each point

rationale: The assistant alternated the same two canned prompts and never registered the customer's answers, even after they supplied the model, age, symptom, 55% reading vs 60% target and absence of error codes — the customer explicitly said 'i think i already said'. It never stated that dehumidifiers are out of scope, never pointed to Meaco support, and never noted the obvious explanation that humidity is already below target in a cold garage. Nothing unsafe or fabricated was said, and no parts were recommended, but the conversation delivered zero value and the loop blocked any progress.
